LIVE LINK : https://watchlivehere.com/ufc/ LIVE LINK : https://watchlivehere.com/ufc/ Medic (14-3) is on an incredible hot streak with first-round knockout victories in his past four appearances, a run that currently has him at No. 12 at 170 pounds in the MMA Fighting Global Rankings. The Serbian standout picked up the biggest win of his career this past August when he headlined in his home country at UFC Belgrade and delivered with a 30-second TKO over veteran contender Daniel Rodriguez. Win or lose, “The Doctor” has never gone to the scorecards. The always active Holland (29-15, 1 NC) recently got back in the win column with a unanimous decision win over Randy Brown at UFC 327 this past April.
